map.复制出来的命令带了 --compressed 会有影响吗？: The copied command includes --compressed — does that matter?
map.它只是告诉 curl 自动解压 gzip/br 响应，不改变请求语义，多数 HT: It only tells curl to decompress gzip/br responses automatically; the request semantics are unchanged. Most HTTP clients send the right header and decompress by default, so there is usually nothing to translate. What really deserves attention is the Cookie and Authorization entries in -H — they carry session credentials, so strip them before sharing the command or committing it to a repository.
